shots.words: My old roommate and I haven't spoken in two years, but we share a playlist.
shots.title:
two years,
one playlist
shots.draw: A phone, big, with a playlist header: two overlapping circles (hers ink, mine cobalt) and track rows writing on.
shots.moves: The phone is already drawing on at frame 0; the two circles slide into overlap; rows write on one by one.

shots.words: It's a Spotify Blend, so every morning it mixes her songs with mine.
shots.draw: Two columns of song rows, hers in ink from the left, mine in cobalt from the right, braiding into one list under a small sun.
shots.moves: Rows slide in from both edges and interleave into one column on 'mixes'.

shots.words: Last month her half was all sad songs at three in the morning.
shots.draw: Only her rows, in ink, each stamped 3:04 am, 3:11 am...; a thin moon at the top; the rows fade soft.
shots.moves: Timestamps write on down the list, the moon draws on.

shots.words: I couldn't text her, so I played our road trip song forty times.
shots.draw: An empty message field with a blinking cursor; below it a cobalt play counter ticking to 40 while a cobalt line runs off like a road.
shots.moves: Cursor blinks, nothing typed; on 'played' the counter ticks up fast and the road line runs across the frame.
shots.change: object: the unsent text -> the counter

shots.words: Next morning, it was the first song in the Blend.
shots.draw: The Blend list again; the top row is the road trip song, washed in cobalt, a small sun beside it.
shots.moves: The top row drops in and lands; the wash spreads under it.
shots.change: back to the list, one row lit

shots.draw: Two play counters side by side: mine 40 in cobalt, hers 41 in ink, hers bigger.
shots.moves: Her counter writes on and ticks past mine.

shots.words: We still haven't said a word. Our match is ninety-eight percent.
shots.draw: An empty chat: 'no messages' in soft; then the two circles slide almost fully together with '98% match' writing on.
shots.moves: The chat stays empty; on 'match' the circles overlap and the number writes on.

shots.draw: Back to the s01 framing: the phone and the playlist header, the circles at 98%.
shots.moves: Rows write on again, looping into frame 0.
